about: The smoke suite run by tools/dev/smoke.ps1. Each scenario is one hidden test run through shoot.ps1. Fields: name; about (what it checks, for the player); script (dev actions, tools/dev/README.md: times from app start, about 2 s after launch); shots (seconds after launch to capture: a beat after the last action); settings (extra settings.json members, starting with a comma); window (also capture this window, by part of its title); desk (also capture every window where it sits); mind (point the profile at tools/dev/mock_mind.py); mindReply; mindRequests (the least the mock must be asked); expect (regexes, case-sensitive, that some log line must match); forbid (more regexes no log line may match, on top of ERROR, Exception and SCRIPT ERROR); ignore (regexes for known harmless lines); beside (first start hidden stand-ins for the player's own app, copies that aren't test runs: one holds a one-copy lock of their own, never the player's, a second must quit at once, and the scenario runs beside them). The top-level ignore applies to every scenario. Calibrate expect and ignore from real runs; never loosen forbid to make a run pass. Which run in a check (smoke.ps1 -Changed, as check.ps1 runs it): every scenario when a file matching one of all changed (shared code and the harness itself); each scenario whose covers match a changed file; and boot whenever a file matching app changed (anything the app runs). Patterns are wildcards on paths from the checkout's root, with forward slashes. READMEs never count (a character's persona.md does: the app reads it), so a change to tests or docs alone runs none; with no list of what changed (git couldn't say, or on main itself), every scenario runs.

scenarios.name: boot
scenarios.about: A fresh profile: the cabinet and the companion come up and nothing in the log goes wrong.

scenarios.name: beside
scenarios.about: A test run goes ahead beside the player's own app (a stand-in holding a one-copy lock of its own, leaving the player's free), while a second such copy still quits at once; the test copy shows no tray icon or Windows notice, never reads the talk key or the mouse, and hears silence instead of opening the microphone.
expect: ^Main: a test run, beside any other copy \(no single-instance lock\), on its own profile
^DesktopWindow: a test run: the player's mouse buttons are never read, nor their pointer followed
^Listening: a test run: the talk key is never read
^Ears: a test run never opens the microphone

scenarios.name: firstrun
scenarios.about: A new player's first run: the Welcome opens beside the cabinet.

scenarios.name: settings
scenarios.about: Every Settings page opens, and none is wider than the window (settingswidths logs any that is).

scenarios.name: chat
scenarios.about: Saying something to the companion reaches their mind (the mock), and their reply shows in their bubble.
scenarios.mindReply: Hi! It's good to see you. How did today go?
expect: ^Chat: her bubble showed its first words \d+ ms after asking, the whole reply

scenarios.name: memory
scenarios.about: The memory book opens on its tabs with a few seeded notes, facts and agenda items; a fact edited is saved on leaving it, and one the companion rewords while it is being edited asks which to keep, then keeps the player's.
expect: ^Memory book: asked which to keep: \S+ changed this meanwhile, to: “Bob promised her a Medium problem.”

scenarios.name: agendacancel
scenarios.about: Asked to take something off the agenda, the companion does it in that reply: the job interview the seed put there leaves the memory book's Agenda tab.
expect: ^Chat: her bubble showed its first words \d+ ms after asking, the whole reply

scenarios.name: crt
scenarios.about: The CRT's small system opens, then its MEMOS app.

scenarios.name: reminder
scenarios.about: A reminder set a few seconds ahead goes off, with its ticket.

scenarios.name: focus
scenarios.about: A focus session starts from the screen and counts down on it.

scenarios.name: memos
scenarios.about: Memos hang and pin on the cabinet's side, and the hanging one opens as a sheet.
